notes: UPPRPB publishes **category-wise and gender-wise cutoffs** with the written exam result. The written paper is out of 300 (150 questions × 2 marks) and the **final merit is built from written exam marks only** — the PET and PST are qualifying, so there is no separate 'final' cutoff list of the SSC type. Figures below are normalised written-exam marks, taken from the official result notices as reproduced in dated reports; always cross-check your category's exact figure in the cutoff PDF on uppbpb.gov.in.
